18	/**
19	 * Derives the stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household, i.e. who share a
20	 * last name and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace). Because the
21	 * identifier is a deterministic digest of that normalized pair, every member of a household computes
22	 * the same value, and it never changes as members join or leave.
23	 */
24	public final class HouseholdIdGenerator {
25	
26	    /** Number of leading hex characters of the digest kept as the identifier. */
27	    private static final int LENGTH = 16;
28	
29	    private HouseholdIdGenerator() {
30	    }
31	
32	    /**
33	     * Produce the household identifier for the given last name and address.
34	     *
35	     * @param lastName the household's last name
36	     * @param address the household's address
37	     * @return a stable, non-blank identifier shared by every owner in the household
38	     */
39	    public static String generate(String lastName, String address) {
40	        String key = TextNormalizer.normalizeForComparison(lastName) + '\n'
41	            + TextNormalizer.normalizeForComparison(address);
42	        return Sha256.hexPrefix(key, LENGTH);
43	    }
44	}

## What changed

The `householdId` is now **deterministic** — `SHA-256(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode)`, first 12 hex chars — so owners sharing a last name and postcode automatically share it, and `sharesHousehold` no longer *creates* the link, it only bypasses the duplicate block.

**`util/HouseholdIdGenerator`** — now hashes `(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode)` at 12 chars instead of `(lastName + address)` at 16. Returns `null` when no postcode is on file (an owner with no postcode belongs to no shared household), mirroring the existing postcode-optional handling.

**`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — computes the deterministic `householdId` for every owner (not just declared members), then applies the new rule: a second owner in an existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409 via the existing `DuplicateIdentityException`) **unless** it declares `sharesHousehold`, in which case it's created as a known member. The old `findOwnersInHousehold`/`joinHousehold`/`isDuplicateIdentity` calls are gone.

**`service/ClinicServiceImpl` + `ClinicService`** — replaced `isDuplicateIdentity` (identity-key match) with `isHouseholdDuplicate` (any existing owner sharing the computed `householdId`); this subsumes the old identity check since `householdId` is part of the identity key. Removed the now-obsolete `findOwnersInHousehold`/`joinHousehold` and their dead imports. In `saveOwner`, the soft-duplicate detector is skipped for declared members — *a declared member is not a suspected duplicate*.

**`model/Owner`** — added a `@Transient declaredHouseholdMember` flag (request-scoped, never persisted) to carry the "declared member" signal from controller to the save logic.

**`service/HouseholdMemberCounter`** — unchanged logic (it already keys off the computed `householdId`, which now drives the household-size input to the membership level); only its javadoc was corrected from "address" to "postcode".

The one existing test (`coreSameLastNameAndPostcodeShareHouseholdId`) and the full suite pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
